name: city-unity
author: akreao
description: kRO's Major City Contribution system: join the City Merchant Union in the Eden Group lobby, collect Union Insignias while hunting, invest them in nine cities, and buy each city's account-bound Unity gear for leveling.

settings.label: Insignia drop chance (%)
settings.description: Chance that a monster kill gives each nearby union member a Union Insignia. 20 is kRO's rate.

settings.label: Contribution multiplier
settings.description: Multiplies the contribution each investment gives, to unlock Unity gear faster. 1 is kRO's amount.
